Telemetry Hybrid Source Routing: Use HERE Maps EV API as primary for official VinFast stations (sub-second OCPP push, hardware diagnostics OUT_OF_SERVICE) and EVCS API for franchised stations (avoids 15-30m roaming batch delay)

Road Network Distance vs Haversine: In coastal, riverine, and expressway zones, straight-line Haversine underestimates route distances by 2.5x-3x; OSRM routing matrix must be queried to avoid misleading navigation reroutes
Polling Resilience: Continuous 5-second interval polling on both HERE EV API and EVCS.vn API sustained 100+ requests over 10 minutes with 0 HTTP 429 rate limit errors and zero Cloudflare WAF blocks
gotchas: Beware of generic .gitignore patterns like lan*/ which match any subdirectory starting with lan (e.g. ui/screens/landscape/); use root-relative /lan*/ instead.
Do not commit hardcoded org.gradle.java.home in gradle.properties to ensure CI/CD runner compatibility across environments.
AGP expandArtProfileWildcards task throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException if baseline-prof.txt contains legacy `->*` wildcards; use `->**(**)**`.
GitHub Actions runner does not support 'secrets' context directly inside step 'if' conditions; use environment variables and evaluate inside the run script.
google-services.json and Keystore files (.jks) must always be kept out of git tracking and added to .gitignore.
Audio ducking requires AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK; activeUtteranceCount must reach 0 before abandoning focus.
FusedLocationProviderClient.lastLocation can return null; getCurrentLocation with PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY and cancellation tokens must be used.
Double tap / fast spam clicks can trigger duplicate navigation intents or rapid Google sign-in launches if not debounced.

Telemetry Latency Hierarchy: EVCS.vn updates available/occupied connector counts faster (near instant, tied directly to VinFast App in-country session backend), whereas HERE Maps EV API exhibits 3-15 minute latency due to Edge CDN caching and international gateway routing (VinFast VN -> Hubject/HERE Europe -> Asia CDN).

Franchised V-GREEN stations (e.g. C.HNO1100, C.HNO1215, C.BNI0324) update in 15-30 minute roaming batches on HERE Maps EV API; real-time plug events during short stops may only appear immediately in EVCS API.
EVCS.vn API suffers occasional network latency jitter (spikes up to 5.4s or 10s timeout), whereas HERE Maps EV API maintains strict 260-450ms response bounds.

HERE Maps provides physical EVSE connector-level state (AVAILABLE, OCCUPIED, OUT_OF_SERVICE) and exact serial cpoEvseEMI3Id, whereas EVCS only provides aggregate counts and cannot distinguish unpowered/broken chargers from occupied ones.
